name: core-heavy-rows
brief: Close the backlog's CORE heavy rows. Rename ObjectRotation's CW90/CW180/CW270 members to Clockwise90/180/270 with a hand-filled EF data migration (Up rewrites stored PlacedObjects.Rotation strings, Down reverses) proven by migration tests against old values, a red step and two injected defects, and move the migration-count ratchet to 4 (T1). Close MASTER-157 / CORE-031 deliberately unchanged, keeping the hand-rolled dispatcher, with re-measured size (8 files, 437 lines; the audit's 233 was exact at 16d594b, DRIFT) and the three maintenance costs verified in code (T2). Close MASTER-178 / CORE-035 deliberately unchanged on a validated census (17 enums, 5 None-at-zero, 12 concrete-at-zero) with a reasoned per-enum disposition; no reachable default is a defect, so no code change (T3). Record the cleared CW90 family in MASTER-130 / CORE-024, which stays part done for the ct and obj residues, and correct the imprecise PathSegmentKind 'same blocker class / both renames' claim: it is persisted by ordinal and its members are not abbreviated (T4).
